games.name: ITEA: Tidy Up Furniture Store
games.description: The big sale is over, and the furniture store is a mess! Pick up scattered items, match furniture sets, and sort homewares in this relaxing first-person tidying game. Unlock upgrades and new departments as you get the store ready to reopen. No timer, just tidy.

games.name: SCRUBBED
games.description: Grab your sponge and sink into an endless pile of dirty dishes. Scrub, foam and rinse at your own pace, earn tips, upgrade your gear and find your zen, one plate at a time.

games.name: OVERDRILL
games.description: A pixel art incremental mining roguelite. Drill through destructible caves, collect ore and build a stronger rig with drones, automated bores and a branching upgrade tree.

games.name: Teeth Are Money
games.description: An incremental horror game about pulling teeth from a living monster. Grip, shake and yank each tooth free, then spend the money on research that turns one hard-won tooth into handfuls at a time. Keep pulling before the contamination fills, and watch the mouth grow.

games.name: Whale Simulator
games.description: A livestream management sim. Lead your streamers all the way up — numbers climbing — until they stand on the national-champion stage. You're more than the operator behind the curtain. When the mood hits, you can jump in yourself, throw gifts, and fight the whole room for that number-one spot.

games.name: Flow Treehouse
games.description: A tiny treehouse tucked into the corner of your desktop. Prince Tomato times your focus, Todudu keeps your to-dos, and Lily plays soft music. Focus, finish tasks and play with them to earn wish points for outfits, playlists and decorations. As the treehouse grows, new fairies move in.

games.name: MEMORY DEALER
games.description: You are a memory trafficker. Harvest stolen memories from captive minds and sell them to BRN CORP. Buy neural implants with your credits, but don't get addicted to your own supply, or you'll lose those memories forever. A shady cyberpunk idle game on your desktop.

games.name: SELF//FORK
games.description: A physics-driven cyberpunk incremental. Fork yourself into data packets, bounce through a hostile mainframe's defense matrix, and reunite the fragments to break free.

games.name: Coremine Corp
games.description: Welcome to CoreMine Corp. Your job here is to set up production chains, manage your electricity, juggle contracts and stock-up while upgrading your factory. Time to prove your worth.

games.name: Unclaimed: Loot or Junk
games.description: Unbox. Sort. Collect. Become a master of discovery by exploring unclaimed packages. Complete every set, from vintage gadgets to "Golden Junk". Sell piles of everyday items to buy new shipments and hunt for truly rare treasures. What will you find in the next box?

games.name: OKEYABILITY
games.description: Rediscover the thrill of Classic Okey (Tile-based Rummy) in a neon-lit, robotic atmosphere! Enjoy traditional rules or use unique abilities to shift the balance. Define your strategy, customize your robot, and claim your spot at the table of the future!

games.name: REAL DEAL
games.description: Run your own electronics store chain. Buy phones, tablets, computers, fridges, and more in bulk, transport them with your truck, and sell them at prices you choose. Manage up to 4 stores with hired employees, but fail to plan well and you won’t be able to pay rent, bills, or salaries.

games.name: Siren's Wrath
games.description: A point-and-click adventure where you are trapped in a psychological loop, relive a tragic event, and return the cursed artifacts to escape the loop, before the curse claims you. But remember, she is watching.

games.name: Paper Florist: Stack & Bloom
games.description: 🌼 Paper Florist is a cozy card stacking puzzle. Match flower orders 🌷 balance wobbly stacks 💌 race the timer ⏳ and grow your tiny florist studio into a blooming success 💐✨

games.name: 挂机后花园.放置牧场AFK back garden.idlepasture
games.description: Create your personal oasis in the corner of your desktop.​ This is a laid-back idle simulation game where simple clicks allow you to grow plants and feed adorable animals. Watch them thrive and multiply, receive surprise letters and gifts, and let the serene ambiance of nature fill your screen.

games.name: Frontiers of the Realms
games.description: Build a realm and a deck to match. Grow villages into cities, shape production chains and play cards for supplies, expansion and tactical support. A turn-based strategy game where rivals act in the same round. Play against AI or challenge friends online.

games.name: Villainville
games.description: Join the outcasts of Villainville in this cozy farming sim adventure where Stardew Valley meets Shrek. Grow magic crops, tame the tiny unicorns, sneak into the night market, and befriend misfit fairy tale characters. Bonus? Find the misery mushroom plague saboteur and redeem the irredeemable.

games.name: Kitten Wool Cup
games.description: A cozy kitten life with a silly streak. Make your snug room by the fire your own, dress your kitten in hats and a Santa beard, and invite friends round. Then curl up and dream of football: chaotic kitten matches with a giant ball of wool, runaway roombas and laser pointers.

games.name: Mewts
games.description: Fight your friends in a chaotic PVP party game. Cute on the outside. Chaos on the inside! Play as Mewts, physics-driven wiggly creatures. Stretch, grab and slam each other in a variety of game modes in a hand-crafted clay world!

games.name: Monolith: Dark Matter
games.description: A round-based FPS for 1–4 players set inside the Monolith — a brutalist complex shaped by living black matter. Fight escalating waves of its marionettes, earn points to unlock new sectors and build your arsenal, and uncover the route to a final encounter.

games.name: Adventure Paws
games.description: Adventure Paws is a pixel-style 2D side-scrolling adventure game where you and your friend will play as two cats, embarking on an exciting journey across a mysterious and unknown continent. Join the black and white cats and set off on this journey full of challenges and surprises!

games.name: Corporate Simulator
games.description: Climb from intern to CEO in this idle/incremental game where your company runs on a living spreadsheet. Hire, crush morale, rig the audits, and rack up ISO certifications... all the way to burnout or a golden retirement. 18 playable visual themes, dozens of hours of progression.

games.name: Touhou Mushroom Defense
games.description: Touhou Mushroom Defense is a Touhou Project fan-made game. It’s a defense game where Marisa turns mushrooms into towers to defeat enemies. In the game, you need to gather materials to build towers and construct towers to block the enemy’s path.

games.name: Meowzic Survivor
games.description: A rhythm-integrated roguelike that fuses survivor-style gameplay with dynamic music mechanics. Your firepower flows directly from the rhythm, meaning your combat build is also your custom game music. It’s time to conquer the universe with your own rhythmic symphony of destruction!

games.name: Football Referee Life Simulator 26
games.description: A realistic referee simulator! Show cards, use VAR, control matches, and rise through your referee career!

games.name: Sarco
games.description: Sarco is a first-person horror game built around constant tension instead of jump scares. Maintain visual contact with the sarcophagus to keep it closed and the primordial being contained. But beware: it will adapt. Explore an abandoned complex and find a way to stop the being before it breaks free.

games.name: Color Factory
games.description: Connect nodes to generate, transform, and blend colors in a relaxing factory automation game. Discover new recipes, unlock powerful nodes through research, and design increasingly efficient production networks as your color factory grows.

games.name: Xmas Squad
games.description: Physics co-op comedy for up to 4 players: deliver presents, steal cookies and save your friends from monsters. One more house and we're outta here. Promise.

games.name: Space Crawlers
games.description: Clear out space battlefields using a physics-based grappling hook. Salvage wreckage, recycle it into resources, upgrade your equipment, and grow your salvage business to unlock increasingly lucrative contracts.

games.name: Spray Days
games.description: Paint, restore, and customize worn-out objects in this satisfying spray painting simulator. Complete quirky commissions, upgrade your tools, expand your workshop, and grow your restoration business - solo or with friends in online co-op!

games.name: Radioactivity
games.description: Radioactivity is a co-op survival horror. You are a Liquidator! Together or alone, help your state clean up post-apocalyptic radioactive wilderness. Plan each deployment, fight radiation spread and the creatures that it produces. Together, make WEA flourish once more!

games.name: Eat Your Moons
games.description: A baby planet with a face wants to eat your moons. Feed it with a toy tractor beam, raise a colony of tiny critters and build silly machines until the whole world works for its mouth. A 90-minute incremental about looking after someone until they grow old.

games.name: Goblin Must Clean
games.description: An incremental cleaning game in first person. You are a goblin with one plate in your hands and a mountain of 500,000 to go. Wash them for Gold and spend the Gold at the hearth, until magic does the dishes for you.

games.name: Sift Happens: Idle Beach Treasure
games.description: Someone on the boardwalk just tossed a cigarette butt onto the beach, and now it's buried in the sand. Sift it out, watch it fly into a bin and get paid. Hire more throwers, let crabs collect for you and keep this idle beach running until the junk turns into treasure.

games.name: Needle in a Haystack Simulator in a Haystack of Needle in a Haystack Simulators
games.description: 5,000,000 games on VAPOR, and all but one are clones. From your bedroom PC, screen procedurally generated store pages, stamp each fake on the detail that gives it away, put bots to work, and dig through the haystack for the one original. An incremental hidden object parody.

games.name: Bingolazo
games.description: A colorful bingo roguelite. Pick which balls to call, mark your cards and chain lines, diagonals and full cards into huge scores. Collect lucky charms that bend the rules, play legendary balls like Saturn and beat the club's bosses, in endless runs or the story mode.

games.name: The Gigglebone Gang: Pantsylvania
games.description: The Gigglebone Gang returns! In Pantsylvania, everybody's pants are serious business. Join the Gigglebone Gang across ten locales and 50 activities — sing-along songs, hidden-object hunts, silly science and interactive stories — in this fully restored 1995 point-and-click edutainment classic.

games.name: Bondoq: Desktop Gunners
games.description: Collect, trade, and build your team of Gunners! Discover heroes with unique weapons and effects, and hunt for rare items. Watch the battles unfold automatically on your desktop!

games.name: Next, Million Worlds
games.description: Expand your civilization to an empire of a million worlds. Balance production and logistics, experiment with economy mods, but don't sweat it. This is the age of expansion; growth is inevitable. This is a relaxed incremental experience where you can optimize and experiment, but you can't lose.

games.name: The King Must Grow
games.description: A physics-based active incremental about a not entirely humble jester with one very important job: Feed cute, entirely innocent slimes to the ever-hungry Slime King. Throw them by hand, then see if you can build systems that do it for you. Just never, ever question the King.

games.name: Tiny Vessel
games.description: A companion idle ARPG that lives beside whatever you are doing. A tiny crew of crash-landed survivors fights along an alien walkway while you work: real loot, a Relay to grow the vessel, depths that demand better gear. Progress keeps going while you are away.

games.name: Festival Fireworks Simulator
games.description: Whenever you want fireworks, the night sky is ready. Click to launch a burst, write a wish across the sky, or build a whole show from the very first shell. Holidays, birthdays and ordinary evenings all deserve a fireworks show.

games.name: Clean 'Em Ocean
games.description: An incremental game about cleaning the ocean with a speedboat, unlocking upgrades, and cleaning more trash. Will you save the ocean?

games.name: An Eggcellent Sorting Game
games.description: Sort thousands of colorful eggs by matching their patterns in this relaxing organizing game. Turn a giant mess into satisfying order, level up 8 skills, meet quirky characters, and complete quests. No rush, no pressure. Just you and an eggnormous pile of eggs!

games.name: The First Pixel
games.description: In the beginning there is a white screen and one black pixel. Click it, and it wakes. Grow it into pattern, memory and meaning, hunt 100 lost relics across erased worlds, and discover what a pixel sees once it has gathered everything. A quiet, mysterious incremental.

games.name: KIBA - Kittys Idle Brick Arena
games.description: Let it brick! Mix & match 20 unique balls across 14 Active, Passive, and Clicker slots to trigger massive chain reactions. Earn gold, smash bricks, and trigger prestige for permanent upgrades. Play actively or just sit back and progress idle!

games.name: Desktop Arrow Defense
games.description: "Desktop Arrow Defense" is an idle tower defense mini-game that runs on your desktop. It lets you work while watching your tiny archer defend against incoming enemies. Upgrade your character's attributes, collect and enhance equipment, unlock skill combinations, and create your legendary archer!

games.name: Edenfinity
games.description: Edenfinity is a relaxing incremental colony game where you guide Adam and Eve as they build a new civilization in Eden. Gather resources, sell your surplus, craft bricks, construct houses, and unlock upgrades.

games.name: Cash & Stash: A Vaultkeeper Story
games.description: After a failed robbery attempt, the bank has been torn apart and left in complete chaos. Now, as the Vaultkeeper, you must sort through more than 16,000 scattered items, return everything to its proper place, and uncover the stories behind the bank’s clients and their valuables.

games.name: All-in Tide
games.description: Adapt to the ever-changing weather. Learn every cave along the shore. Swing your shovel and dig up whatever the sea has hidden. But never lose sight of your own desires — they can drive you mad, or make you filthy rich.

games.name: Over The Gnome!
games.description: Become a giant gnome-crushing boulder. Chase the treasure gnomes, shrink the giant yetis with your shrink ray, grow and improve until you crush them all. Travel through 5 unique worlds, prestige, and unlock permanent talents to become unstoppable.

games.name: Gas Station Simulator
games.description: A gas station and convenience store tycoon. Stock shelves, pump fuel, and ring up sales. Grow from a humble roadside stall by pricing stock and unlocking licenses to upgrade your shop. Set out every product by hand, tidy up what customers leave behind, and grow a thriving business.

games.name: Grape by Grape
games.description: A cozy vineyard idler where your cursor makes vines grow. Turn 14 grape varieties into aged wine, raisins, vinegar and pekmez; automate six connected estate stations and fill customer orders. No frantic clicking, no failure—just one more harvest, bottle and upgrade.

games.name: Pixel Ping Pong
games.description: A relaxing idle incremental game where you break tiles, earn coins, and upgrade your growing swarm of balls. Aim your shots to speed up your progress, or sit back and let the game play itself.

games.name: Astrobreaker
games.description: Astrobreaker is a short incremental game about making a spaceship faster and more powerful. Mine planets, gather resources, and upgrade your ship.

games.name: ACT OUT
games.description: A chaotic online party game of 3D charades. Grab a floppy puppet, act out your secret word on a live theater stage, and race your friends to guess it before the clock runs out. Push-to-talk voice, custom Workshop maps, and a winner's podium. Best with 3+ friends.

games.name: OnlyCats
games.description: Pet cats, earn love, buy more cats. OnlyCats is a cozy incremental idle game where hovering over adorable pixel cats fills your coin and love stash. Unlock new cats, grow your collection, and discover more upgrades.

games.name: Incremental Garden
games.description: A short incremental game about a magical garden. Grow wonderful flowers, earn money, buy upgrades, and roll the gacha to discover rarer plants! Over 30 unique plants are waiting for you!

games.name: Over Package!
games.description: Over Package! is a chaotic, physics-based multiplayer party game. Clash with your friends in hilarious arena brawls to deliver cargo. Outsmart rivals with dynamic environmental destruction, leverage chaotic physics, and turn every delivery into absolute combat logistics madness!

games.name: Juicy Fugitives
games.description: Hunt down the most wanted fruits in this cartoon third-person shooter. Play as a pirate crew framed by a mysterious fire, blast through waves of enemies across 5 kingdoms, and survive slapstick boss fights, solo or in 3 player online co-op.
